info.title: Voidwall HTTP API
info.description: Detect PII in arbitrary text, JSON, CSV, and TSV bodies with `POST /v1/scan`. The body itself is the content to scan — there is no JSON envelope. The `Content-Type` header drives parsing. `POST /beta/litellm_basic_guardrail_api` serves LiteLLM's Generic Guardrail API. `http_api.scan.enabled` and `http_api.litellm.enabled` turn each route on or off.

post.description:
Scans one LiteLLM guardrail payload and answers `NONE` or `BLOCKED`. On the
request side it reads `structured_messages`, `tools`, and `tool_calls`, and
`texts` only when `structured_messages` is missing. On the response side it
reads `texts` and `tool_calls`. It never reads `request_data` or
`request_headers`, and never scans base64 data.

requestBody.description: A LiteLLM Generic Guardrail API payload.

200.description: Scan completed: `NONE`, or `BLOCKED` with the kinds found

400.description: Body is not a JSON object with an `input_type` of `request` or `response`

413.description: Body exceeds configured `max_body_size`, or, with `on_error = fail_close`, a model guard needs more windows than its limit

422.description: A content part has a type Voidwall cannot scan and `on_error = fail_close`

500.description: A guard failed (scanner or model inference) and `on_error = fail_close`

post.summary: Scan a request body for PII
post.description:
Inspects the body for PII according to the configured detector set and
returns the kinds detected along with per-kind match counts. The body
itself is never echoed back.

requestBody.description: Raw body content to scan for PII. The `Content-Type` header determines how the body is parsed and scanned.

400.description: Body could not be parsed for the declared `Content-Type`

413.description: Body exceeds configured `max_body_size`, or, with `on_error = fail_close`, a model guard needs more windows than its limit

415.description: `Content-Type` is not in the configured allowlist

500.description: A guard failed (scanner or model inference) and `on_error = fail_close`

error.description: Human-readable error description. Never contains matched PII values.

example.error: malformed body for declared content type

GuardrailRequest.description:
A LiteLLM Generic Guardrail API payload. Only the fields Voidwall reads are
listed; any other field, including `request_data` and `request_headers`, is
accepted and ignored.

images.description:
Image URLs. Never scanned; each `data:` URL is counted in
`voidwall_unscanned_total`. Request side: read only when
`structured_messages` is missing.

input_type.description: Which side of the call the payload carries.

structured_messages.description: Request side: the call's messages in OpenAI Chat Completions format.

texts.description:
Response side: the model's text. Request side: read only when
`structured_messages` is missing.

tool_calls.description: Both sides: tool calls in OpenAI Chat Completions format.

tools.description: Request side: tool definitions in OpenAI Chat Completions format.

blocked_reason.description:
`Voidwall blocked the message. Kinds: ` and the sorted kinds,
joined by `, `. Never contains a detected value.

GuardrailResponse.description:
The answer to LiteLLM. There is no `GUARDRAIL_INTERVENED` variant, because
Voidwall never rewrites a message.

example.blocked_reason: Voidwall blocked the message. Kinds: EMAIL, US_SSN

InputType.description: The side of the call LiteLLM is guarding.

detected.description: Whether any PII was detected in the body.

kinds.description:
Distinct PII kinds detected (e.g. `EMAIL`, `US_SSN`). Operator-defined
custom labels surface here using their configured `label`. The full
list of built-in labels is appended to this description at
spec-generation time.
